selfSurvey.title: Self site survey
selfSurvey.withCustomer: Sent to the customer. They have not finished it yet.
selfSurvey.receivedHint: The answers are saved as the survey's report fields and the photos are on this step. Approve opens the same form as a field survey; fill in the cable lengths and shade-free area from the photos.
selfSurvey.creditNone: No discount was taken off a payment.
selfSurvey.photos: Photos are listed under the evidence of this step.
selfSurvey.askAgainHint: Pick only what is wrong or missing. Only those items are asked.
selfSurvey.visitHint: Cancels the self survey (no discount) and sends the customer the days to pick.
selfSurvey.asked: Asked again. The customer has been told.
selfSurvey.visited: The customer is sent the days to pick. No discount.

credit.title: Self-survey discount
credit.pending: {amount} is waiting: no payment that has not fallen due could take it. It is applied by itself if one can later. Finance was told.
credit.reason: How was it given? (a cheque, cash, a lower final bill)
credit.settled: Marked as given. It is in the log.
